ios.desc:
Introducing Subtitly, the must-have app for live transcription and translation, designed to keep you connected in any conversation. Whether you’re traveling, learning a new language, or simply need help hearing clearly, Subtitly has you covered—all without ever needing Wi-Fi.

Why Choose Subtitly?

	•	Accurate Live Transcription: Get crystal-clear, real-time transcription of conversations, with industry-leading accuracy.
	•	Live Translate in 20+ Languages: Understand and be understood across languages—Subtitly supports English, Spanish, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, and more!
	•	Private On-Device AI: Your data is yours alone. Everything is processed on your device, so your conversations stay private.
	•	Works Offline, Anytime: No signal? No problem. Subtitly works wherever you are, ensuring privacy and convenience on the go.
	•	Store and Access Transcripts: Save and organize all your conversations in one place, perfect for reviewing key moments.
	•	Fully Customizable: Tailor the app to fit your needs.

Loved by Users Worldwide

With a 4.9-star rating, users call Subtitly a “lifesaver” and say it makes every conversation accessible. Don’t miss out—download Subtitly today and stay connected, informed, and in control.

Live Transcribe with Subtitly is the better alternative to Otter, Wave AI, Turbolearn AI, Otter AI, Coconote.

show_hn.title: Show HN: macOS Realtime Subtitles with Local Whisper Turbo

quotes.text:
I have hearing issues and I do not always understand what people are saying to me.

Launch of Whisper Large v3 Turbo helped me to create an app with realtime, reliable and local  subtitles and translations for Mac. Whisper large v3 have support of 70+ languages, so it will work pretty much for everyone globally. Subtitles (or Translations) will be in Mac's Notch so on call you will always look into the camera.

+ Due to Apple's Silicon Chips it is possible to do it offline, so it is good for both privacy reasons and offline access.

App will be available on 21st of October. It will be free for first 20 minutes to prove value.
